source.datasetRecord: PMC13413517; doxorubicin cardiotoxicity in male Sprague–Dawley rats
source.citation: Goje ID et al. Empagliflozin Protects Against Doxorubicin Cardiotoxicity: Integrative Assessment of Cardiac Kinetics and Electrophysiology Using Machine Learning in a Rat Model. Medical Sciences. 2026;14:342.
source.primaryProtocolCitation: Goje et al. 2026, Methods: Animal Model of Doxorubicin-Induced Cardiotoxicity; Results: ECG Findings and Figure 11

supportingSources.citation: Alghamdi SA et al. Dual therapy with allicin and metformin provides superior cardioprotection against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in rats compared to monotherapy. Frontiers in Pharmacology. 2025;16:1725943.
supportingSources.role: independent 18 mg/kg cumulative doxorubicin rat pathology and biomarker evidence

protocol.frequency: 2.5 mg/kg every 48 hours; cumulative doxorubicin dose 15 mg/kg
protocol.control: Control received daily water by oral gavage and 0.9% saline intraperitoneally at 48-hour intervals

histopathology.finding: Cardiac histopathology total score 10/15: degeneration, pyknosis, cell infiltration, necrosis and fibre fragmentation each scored 2/3
CK-MB, LDH and cardiac troponin-I were elevated versus control (all p < 0.0001)
GSH, GPx, SOD, CAT and nitric oxide were reduced; MDA increased versus control (all reported p < 0.0001)

cardiacFunction.finding: lower heart rate with prolonged QRS, PR, QT and QTc intervals
reduced R-wave amplitude and negative T-wave morphology
all five doxorubicin hearts scored above 7.3 on the cohort-relative optical cardiotoxicity score

websiteUse.scope: Rat cumulative doxorubicin myocardial injury: ECG, biomarkers and histopathology teaching.
approvedClaims: Reported cardiac biomarker and ECG changes
displayRequirements: Show cumulative dose and study arm
Label graph-only biomarker magnitudes as unavailable

blockingIssues: ECG and serum biomarker magnitudes are presented graphically and have not been digitized or independently checked
The optical 1–10 cardiotoxicity score is cohort-relative; the supporting pathology score is a distinct 0–15 study-specific score
No source-reported NOAEL/LOAEL has been extracted
A second reviewer has not yet checked the transcription
